title: Leaving Atlanta, her mother's family and who was musical
summary: She left Atlanta at 3 or 4. Her mother's family, including a great-grandmother, all came from Atlanta; only she and her mother were musical, apart from a twin brother who danced.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Down in Atlanta, you stayed there until what - 3 or 4?
Until I was, I think, 3 or 4. It's difficult, it's been so long, to remember how old I was because I never heard them tell me how old I was when we left Atlanta. I think I was between 3 and 4.
Do you know how old your mother was when you left Atlanta?
No. I know one time in Pittsburgh we had one of the youngest generations in America, it was listed as that in Pittsburgh.
See, my great-grandmother was living when I was born and my sister got married before she died and had a little baby. I think my mother must have married when she was 16.
You mentioned your great-grandmother. This was on your mother's side?
Did they all come from Atlanta?
And had been there for several generations?
Aside from your mother, were they musical particularly?
No, I think only my mother and myself. My brother, the twin brother - you know, the two twins I mentioned - he was musical but he didn't work at it. He could dance and play a little piano.
